SELECT
  dim_unidades.id AS "id_interno",
  dim_unidades.unidade AS "Unidade",
  dim_unidades.marca AS "Marca",
  dim_unidades.boutique AS "Boutique",
  COUNT(*)::int AS "Respostas",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nps.comentario ~ '\S')::int AS "Comentários",
  ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nps.nota >= 9) - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nps.nota <= 6))
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::int AS "NPS",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nps_ia.analise->>'temperatura' IN ('3 Alta','4 Crítica'))::int AS "Alertas"
FROM public.nps
JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
LEFT JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario)))
WHERE dim_unidades.marca IN ('ITC Vertebral','Instituto Trata')
  [[AND {{data}}]]
  [[AND {{marca}}]]
  [[AND {{boutique}}]]
GROUP BY dim_unidades.id, dim_unidades.unidade, dim_unidades.marca, dim_unidades.boutique
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nps.comentario ~ '\S') >= 40
ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nps.comentario ~ '\S') DESC

WITH alerta_90 AS (
    -- universo de alertas dos ultimos 90 dias, base para recorrencia
    SELECT n.id_interno, ia.analise AS a
    FROM public.nps n
    JOIN public.nps_ia ia ON ia.hash = COALESCE(n.hash, md5(btrim(n.comentario)))
    WHERE ia.analise->>'temperatura' IN ('3 Alta','4 Crítica')
      AND n.data >= now() - interval '90 days'
),
rec_unid AS (
    SELECT id_interno, COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerta_90 GROUP BY 1
),
rec_area AS (
    SELECT id_interno, x AS area, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM alerta_90, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(a->'areas') x
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  dim_unidades.id      AS "id_interno",
  dim_unidades.marca   AS "Marca",
  dim_unidades.unidade AS "Unidade",
  dim_unidades.boutique AS "Boutique",
  dim_unidades.socio   AS "Sócio",
  CASE nps_ia.analise->>'temperatura'
    WHEN '4 Crítica' THEN 'Crítica'
    WHEN '3 Alta'    THEN 'Alta'
  END AS "Urgência",
  nps.nota AS "Nota",
  nps_ia.analise->>'dor'     AS "Dor",
  nps_ia.analise->>'intuito' AS "Intuito",
  (SELECT string_agg(x, ', ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(nps_ia.analise->'areas') x) AS "Áreas",
  COALESCE(rec_unid.n, 0)::int AS "Alertas 90d",
  (SELECT ra.area || ' ×' || ra.n
     FROM rec_area ra
    WHERE ra.id_interno = nps.id_interno
      AND ra.area IN (SELECT y FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(nps_ia.analise->'areas') y)
      AND ra.n >= 2
    ORDER BY ra.n DESC, ra.area LIMIT 1) AS "Padrão",
  nps.comentario AS "Comentário",
  nps.data::date AS "Data",
  'Abrir relatório 📄' AS "Relatório"
FROM public.nps
JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
LEFT JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario)))
LEFT JOIN rec_unid ON rec_unid.id_interno = nps.id_interno
WHERE dim_unidades.marca IN ('ITC Vertebral','Instituto Trata')
  AND nps_ia.analise->>'temperatura' IN ('3 Alta','4 Crítica')
  [[AND {{data}}]]
  [[AND {{marca}}]]
  [[AND {{boutique}}]]
  [[AND CASE nps_ia.analise->>'temperatura' WHEN '4 Crítica' THEN 'Crítica' WHEN '3 Alta' THEN 'Alta' END = {{urgencia}}]]
  [[AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(nps_ia.analise->'areas') a WHERE a ILIKE '%' || {{area}} || '%')]]
  [[AND nps_ia.analise->>'intuito' = {{intuito}}]]
ORDER BY nps.data DESC,
         CASE WHEN nps_ia.analise->>'temperatura' = '4 Crítica' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         COALESCE(rec_unid.n,0) DESC

-- Evolucao do NPS, 12 meses fixos (independente do filtro Data da aba)
SELECT date_trunc('month', nps.data)::date AS "Mês",
       ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nps.nota >= 9) - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nps.nota <= 6))
             / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::int AS "NPS",
       COUNT(*)::int AS "Respostas"
FROM public.nps
JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
WHERE dim_unidades.marca IN ('ITC Vertebral','Instituto Trata')
  AND nps.data >= now() - interval '12 months'
  [[AND {{marca}}]]
  [[AND {{boutique}}]]
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

-- Recorrencia por area, janela fixa de 90 dias (independente do filtro Data da aba)
SELECT x AS "Área", COUNT(*)::int AS "Alertas"
FROM public.nps
JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario))),
     LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(nps_ia.analise->'areas') x
WHERE dim_unidades.marca IN ('ITC Vertebral','Instituto Trata')
  AND nps_ia.analise->>'temperatura' IN ('3 Alta','4 Crítica')
  AND nps.data >= now() - interval '90 days'
  [[AND {{marca}}]]
  [[AND {{boutique}}]]
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

-- Boutiques por sensibilidade, 6 meses. Contagem absoluta (N por boutique e baixo demais para %).
WITH neg AS (
  SELECT nps.nota AS nota, dim_unidades.marca AS marca,
         dim_unidades.boutique AS boutique, nps_ia.analise AS a
  FROM public.nps
  JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
  JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario)))
  WHERE dim_unidades.marca IN ('ITC Vertebral','Instituto Trata')
    AND nps.data >= now() - interval '6 months'
    AND (nps_ia.analise->>'intuito' IN ('Reclamação','Risco de cancelamento')
         OR nps_ia.analise->>'sentimento' = 'Negativo')
    [[AND {{marca}}]]
    [[AND {{boutique}}]]
),
dom AS (
  SELECT neg.boutique AS boutique, x AS tema,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY neg.boutique ORDER BY count(*) DESC, x) AS rn
  FROM neg, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(neg.a->'areas') x
  GROUP BY neg.boutique, x
)
SELECT neg.boutique                                                   AS "Boutique",
       string_agg(DISTINCT CASE neg.marca WHEN 'ITC Vertebral' THEN 'ITC' ELSE 'Trata' END, ' + ') AS "Marcas",
       count(*)                                                       AS "Negativos",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE neg.nota <= 6)                          AS "Detratores",
       round(avg(neg.nota), 1)                                        AS "Nota média",
       round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE neg.nota <= 6)/count(*), 0)  AS "% detrator",
       (SELECT d.tema FROM dom d WHERE d.boutique = neg.boutique AND d.rn = 1) AS "Tema dominante"
FROM neg
GROUP BY neg.boutique
HAVING round(avg(neg.nota), 1) < 8   -- corte de ruido: aba de alertas, verde nao e alerta
ORDER BY 4 DESC, 3 DESC

-- Detratores por tema, marca fixa. Detratores = comentario do tema com nota <= 6.
-- Tema com zero detrator fica fora: aba de alertas.
WITH neg AS (
  SELECT nps.nota AS nota, nps_ia.analise AS a
  FROM public.nps
  JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
  JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario)))
  WHERE dim_unidades.marca = 'ITC Vertebral'
    AND nps.data >= now() - interval '6 months'
    AND (nps_ia.analise->>'intuito' IN ('Reclamação','Risco de cancelamento')
         OR nps_ia.analise->>'sentimento' = 'Negativo')
    [[AND {{boutique}}]]
)
SELECT x                                        AS "Tema",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE neg.nota <= 6)    AS "Detratores"
FROM neg, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(neg.a->'areas') x
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE neg.nota <= 6) > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC

-- Detratores por tema, marca fixa. Detratores = comentario do tema com nota <= 6.
-- Tema com zero detrator fica fora: aba de alertas.
WITH neg AS (
  SELECT nps.nota AS nota, nps_ia.analise AS a
  FROM public.nps
  JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
  JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario)))
  WHERE dim_unidades.marca = 'Instituto Trata'
    AND nps.data >= now() - interval '6 months'
    AND (nps_ia.analise->>'intuito' IN ('Reclamação','Risco de cancelamento')
         OR nps_ia.analise->>'sentimento' = 'Negativo')
    [[AND {{boutique}}]]
)
SELECT x                                        AS "Tema",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE neg.nota <= 6)    AS "Detratores"
FROM neg, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(neg.a->'areas') x
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE neg.nota <= 6) > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC

-- Sensibilidade por tema, janela fixa de 6 meses.
-- Tabelas SEM alias: as tags de filtro geram "public"."dim_unidades"."<col>".
WITH neg AS (
  SELECT nps.nota AS nota, nps_ia.analise AS a
  FROM public.nps
  JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
  JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario)))
  WHERE dim_unidades.marca IN ('ITC Vertebral','Instituto Trata')
    AND nps.data >= now() - interval '6 months'
    AND (nps_ia.analise->>'intuito' IN ('Reclamação','Risco de cancelamento')
         OR nps_ia.analise->>'sentimento' = 'Negativo')
    [[AND {{marca}}]]
    [[AND {{boutique}}]]
),
tot AS (SELECT count(*)::numeric AS c FROM neg)
SELECT x                                                            AS "Tema",
       count(*)                                                     AS "Negativos",
       round(100*count(*)/NULLIF((SELECT c FROM tot),0), 1)          AS "% dos comentários",
       round(avg(neg.nota), 1)                                       AS "Nota média",
       round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE neg.nota <= 6)/count(*), 0) AS "% detrator",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE neg.nota <= 6)                         AS "Detratores"
FROM neg, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(neg.a->'areas') x
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 6 DESC, 2 DESC

-- Resumo de comentarios negativos, marca fixa (padrao das abas de producao). Janela de 6 meses.
WITH resp AS (
  SELECT count(*)::numeric AS n
  FROM public.nps
  JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
  WHERE dim_unidades.marca = 'ITC Vertebral'
    AND nps.data >= now() - interval '6 months'
),
neg AS (
  SELECT nps.nota AS nota
  FROM public.nps
  JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
  JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario)))
  WHERE dim_unidades.marca = 'ITC Vertebral'
    AND nps.data >= now() - interval '6 months'
    AND (nps_ia.analise->>'intuito' IN ('Reclamação','Risco de cancelamento')
         OR nps_ia.analise->>'sentimento' = 'Negativo')
    [[AND {{boutique}}]]
)
SELECT count(*)                                                        AS "Negativos",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE nota <= 6)                               AS "Detratores",
       round(avg(nota), 1)                                             AS "Nota média",
       round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE nota <= 6)/NULLIF(count(*),0), 0) AS "% detrator",
       round(100*count(*)/NULLIF((SELECT n FROM resp), 0), 1)          AS "% da base"
FROM neg

-- Resumo de comentarios negativos, marca fixa (padrao das abas de producao). Janela de 6 meses.
WITH resp AS (
  SELECT count(*)::numeric AS n
  FROM public.nps
  JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
  WHERE dim_unidades.marca = 'Instituto Trata'
    AND nps.data >= now() - interval '6 months'
),
neg AS (
  SELECT nps.nota AS nota
  FROM public.nps
  JOIN public.dim_unidades ON dim_unidades.id = nps.id_interno
  JOIN public.nps_ia ON nps_ia.hash = COALESCE(nps.hash, md5(btrim(nps.comentario)))
  WHERE dim_unidades.marca = 'Instituto Trata'
    AND nps.data >= now() - interval '6 months'
    AND (nps_ia.analise->>'intuito' IN ('Reclamação','Risco de cancelamento')
         OR nps_ia.analise->>'sentimento' = 'Negativo')
    [[AND {{boutique}}]]
)
SELECT count(*)                                                        AS "Negativos",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE nota <= 6)                               AS "Detratores",
       round(avg(nota), 1)                                             AS "Nota média",
       round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE nota <= 6)/NULLIF(count(*),0), 0) AS "% detrator",
       round(100*count(*)/NULLIF((SELECT n FROM resp), 0), 1)          AS "% da base"
FROM neg
